verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares documents a secured, automatically populated data room. Documents are collected as workflows complete, the data room is smart-linked to the cap table, and it is included even on the entry pricing tier. That covers the diligence-ready, cap-table-plus-documents core. However, nothing in the evidence shows the ops user granting permissioned access to external counsel or investors. Missing for 10: documented external sharing or invitations for counsel and investors, granular permission controls, investor-facing cap table views, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
